title: Expression Add Operators
description: Find all ways to add operators (+, -, *) between digits of a string to equal a target value.

steps.note: Initialize recursion with index 0, sum 0, lastOperand 0, empty path.
First digit: include 1 as the start of the expression.
Recursive call: index=1, currentSum=1, lastOperand=1, path='1'.
Reached end of string, valid expression '1+2+3' added to results.
